slug: 2018-06-06 Equatorial Guinea and Cameroon are now more connected - AFR-IX telecom

facts.fact: AFR-IX (2018-06-06) states Ceiba-2, a 400 km cable linking Malabo, Bata and Kribi (Cameroon), was inaugurated on 4 June 2018 as the first direct international fibre link, alongside the ACE cable: two routes in service.
The ACE consortium states the cable entered service on 15 December 2012 and is the first international submarine cable to land in Equatorial Guinea, at Bata.

note: Access: only a vague statement that agreements are being put in place for other operators; no fact.

facts.fact: AidData record of the China Eximbank loan states the Ceiba-2 cable, a 400 km submarine system owned and operated by GITGE connecting Malabo and Bata with a branching unit to Kribi in Cameroon, was built under the loan (status Completed, end year 2017).

The same record states the Ceiba-2 and ACE submarine stations in Bata sit next to each other and are directly fibre-linked, so GNQ has both ACE and Ceiba-2 at Bata; same station, so two not independent.

note: Loan record; in-service date inferred from status Completed and end year 2017.
